value.rationale: Sharpness of monitoring-product bounds across all cycle aspect ratios is a natural unresolved regime left open by the published square example. The lower bound could have had a growing gap; the explicit balanced incidence design proves equality uniformly and isolates two small aspect-ratio exceptions of the basic pattern. This resolves a natural exact infinite-family optimization problem, not a mere renaming or tiny numerical improvement.
